comment: Public awareness signals for the constructive-notice gradient: candidate dates from which an organization's awareness clock could be argued to run. Each entry needs date (ISO), tier, label, and citation; granularity 'year' means the event is dated big-picture to Jan 1 and displayed as the year only; 'month' means dated to the 1st and displayed as month + year. Adding an event is a data commit — include the citation and keep labels short. Tier order in the UI: statute-regulation, standards, intergovernmental, survey, industry. The EPISTEMIC tier (per Darren's ruling of 2026-07-18, modifying guardrail B-1) marks the issue's coming-into-existence — Shor's algorithm, the founding of the PQC field — and is DISPLAY-ONLY: never selectable as an awareness anchor, never in the notice ladder; existence precedes duty (manuscript Part II.A). The Mosca 2015/2018 scholarship question remains open pending ruling. Events dated 2026 carry citations marked 'full citation pending' — supplied by Darren, to be completed by data commit.
